name: Electronics and home appliances retail

problems.words: Qist wale teen chaar qiston ke baad dena band kar dete hain
quick_ideas: List every installment account with its last payment date once, so you see who is late
Call the oldest late accounts first, so effort goes where risk is highest.

workzap_build.text: an installment ledger with account codes, schedule, paid, due and overdue days, and a daily overdue list.

problems.free_stops: How accounts are coded and overdue lists produced is in the solution document.

problems.words: Recovery wala cash laata hai, pata nahi sab jama hua ya nahi
quick_ideas: Match the recovery man's copy with your register once, so you see if they agree
Give a receipt for every collection, so the customer has proof too.

workzap_build.text: collections logged on phone with a WhatsApp receipt to the customer and daily collector cash reconciliation.

problems.ask_first: When does the collected cash reach you?
problems.free_stops: How collections are logged and reconciled is in the solution document.

never_say: Interest, markup or Shariah rulings on installments, or financing advice. Recovery by threats or seizing goods. Electrical, gas or wiring safety advice; for fire, shock or gas leaks, emergency services first. Selling grey imports as warranty-backed or altering serials. To collect CNICs, guarantor details or cheques.

sample_reply.person: Qiston pe saman dete hain, 300 ke qareeb accounts hain, recovery ka koi hisaab nahi. Kya karein?
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, ye theek ho sakta hai, aur is hafte hi shuruaat ho sakti hai. 1 Har account ki aakhri qist ki tareekh ek dafa list kar lein, taa ke pata chale kaun late hai. 2 Recovery wale ki copy apne register se ek dafa mila lein, taa ke dono ka farq saamne aaye. Workzap ye aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: installment ledger jis mein roz late accounts ki list aaye, aur har collection pe customer ko WhatsApp receipt aur shaam ko cash ka hisaab. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
